items.title: Eddie Miller and Pete Fountain Interview, 1970-01-09
items.q: Paul Desmond, the great alto saxophone player with the Brubeck Group for so many years, is writing a book

ctx.x: Thank you. Thank you. Shall we get the other question out of the way? What size mouthpiece do you use? The leg. The leg, you know. I told these guys during the break that Paul Desmond, the great alto saxophone player with the Brubeck Group for so many years, is writing a book about his experiences with the band. And the title of the book is going to be a question that he was incessantly asked on airplanes by stewardesses. And that was, how many of you are there in the quartet? In the quartet. Yeah. Here's another…
I'd like to talk to Eddie Miller, please.
